name: Montravel

limits: For red wine, Merlot: at least 50%
For white wine, Sémillon: at least 25%
For white wine, Sauvignon Blanc and Sauvignon Gris together: at least 25%
For white wine, Ondenc: at most 10%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Merlot, Sémillon and Sauvignon Blanc sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

blurb.text: A Bergerac appellation in South West France for white wines from Sauvignon, Sémillon and Muscadelle, and for Merlot-led reds.
